question: An object is dropped from a height of 78.4 m. What is the time taken to reach the ground? (Use g = 9.8 { m/s}² )
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To determine the time taken by the object to reach the ground, we use the formula for motion under gravity: **h = (1/2) × g × t²**, where:

 
 
• **h** is the height from which the object is dropped, which is **78.4 m**.
 
• **g** is the acceleration due to gravity, which is **9.8 m/s²**.
 
• **t** is the time taken by the object to reach the ground.
 
 
 
• Rearranging the formula to solve for **t**:
 
 
• **t² = (2 × h) / g**
 
• **t = √[(2 × h) / g]**
 
 
 
• Substituting the values:
 
 
• **t = √[(2 × 78.4) / 9.8]**
 
• **t = √(156.8 / 9.8)**
